admission.justification: Spans packaging, internal grammar consumers, Dagger, bootstrap, pytest isolation, and process-state reset registration, guarded by CLI/bootstrap and process-state tests, preventing re-introduction of privileged venv grammar wheels or broken offline CI/pytest runs.

applicability: Packaging metadata (mcp/pyproject.toml, mcp/uv.lock), internal grammar consumers (canvas/kit_references.py, review_memo_store.py), Dagger candidate/portable containers, post-transaction bootstrap (scripts/bootstrap-mcp-venv.sh), pytest HOME isolation (mcp/tests/conftest.py), and process-state reset registration (global_state.py).
conditions: mcp/pyproject.toml and mcp/uv.lock depend only on core tree-sitter==0.26.1 with zero privileged tree-sitter-* grammar packages.
Internal consumers load grammars and compute memo namespaces through the uniform catalog seam instead of direct tree_sitter_* imports.

Dagger containers mount and warm AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE, bootstrap-mcp-venv.sh pre-warms strictly after trap - EXIT outside the venv transaction, conftest.py preserves host AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE across HOME isolation, and global_state.py registers all new module caches.
exclusions: Offline hosts where post-transaction bootstrap pre-warm warns still retain a valid frozen venv and warm grammars lazily when next needed.

evidence: ./.githooks/_gate.sh fast (PASS 10/10), ./.githooks/_gate.sh targeted (PASS), wheel packaging check (PASS), 37-module clean-copy pytest (377 passed, 4 skipped, 142 subtests passed), 3-module Dagger/profile pytest (16 passed), and live Dagger cadence-evidence (exit 0, warmed=javascript,python,tsx,typescript) on exact tree 825dedbe9356776ebe13f67d9a5dc9c331c295d6

statement: mcp/pyproject.toml and mcp/uv.lock declare zero privileged tree-sitter-* grammar packages (only core tree-sitter), all internal consumers load grammars through the uniform catalog seam, wheel packaging ships the lock and query files, and Dagger, certification rails, post-transaction bootstrap, and pytest pre-warm and share AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE.
title: Zero tree-sitter-* venv deps with shared AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE pre-warm
